{{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{use mdy dates|date=April 2022}} {{Infobox television season | bgcolor = #A9A9A9 | image = DancingSeason17.jpg | caption = Promotional poster | module1 = {{Infobox reality competition season | host = {{Plainlist| * [[Tom Bergeron]] * [[Brooke Burke Charvet]] }} | judges = {{Plainlist| * [[Carrie Ann Inaba]] * [[Len Goodman]] * [[Bruno Tonioli]] }} | celebrity_winner = [[Amber Riley]] | professional_winner = [[Derek Hough]] }} | num_episodes = 12 | network = [[American Broadcasting Company|ABC]] | first_aired = {{start date|2013|9|16}} | last_aired = {{end date|2013|11|26}} }} '''Season seventeen''' of ''[[Dancing with the Stars (American TV series)|Dancing with the Stars]]'' premiered on September 16, 2013, on the [[American Broadcasting Company|ABC]] network.{{cite web |url=https://twitter.com/DancingABC/status/403322965627916289 |title=Twitter / DancingABC: Tuesday at 9|8c on the |publisher=Twitter.com |access-date=2013-11-27 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131202231111/https://twitter.com/DancingABC/status/403322965627916289 |archive-date=2013-12-02 |url-status=live }} On November 26, actress [[Amber Riley]] and [[Derek Hough]] were crowned the champions, while actor [[Corbin Bleu]] and [[Karina Smirnoff]] finished in second place, and [[Jack Osbourne]] and [[Cheryl Burke]] finished in third. This is the first season since season one to not have a Tuesday results show.{{cite web|url = http://tvbythenumbers.zap2it.com/2013/05/14/abc-2013-14-primetime-schedule-marvels-agents-of-s-h-i-e-l-d-on-tuesday-revenge-sticks-with-sunday-once-upon-a-time-spinoff-on-thursday/182567/|title = ABC 2013-14 Primetime Schedule: 'Marvel's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.' on Tuesday, 'Revenge' Sticks With Sunday, 'Once Upon a Time' Spinoff on Thursday, 'DWTS' Downsized & More|first = Amanda|date = May 14, 2013|publisher = TV by the Numbers|last = Kondolojy|access-date = June 1, 2013|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20130607112549/http://tvbythenumbers.zap2it.com/2013/05/14/abc-2013-14-primetime-schedule-marvels-agents-of-s-h-i-e-l-d-on-tuesday-revenge-sticks-with-sunday-once-upon-a-time-spinoff-on-thursday/182567/|archive-date = June 7, 2013|url-status = dead}} The sky box where host [[Brooke Burke|Brooke Burke Charvet]] interviewed dancers after their performances was also eliminated. Instead, the couples were accommodated in a new seating area near the judges' table, which had also been shifted to the opposite side of the ballroom. A make-up room and rehearsal room were added where Charvet could chat with the couples before and after their performances.{{cite web|url = http://www.tvguide.com/News/Dancing-With-The-Stars-Changes-Conrad-Green-Season17-1070353.aspx|title = Dancing with the Stars Boss Teases This Season's Big Changes|first = Liz|date = September 15, 2013|publisher = TV Guide|last = Raftery|access-date = September 15, 2013|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20130918055157/http://www.tvguide.com/News/Dancing-With-The-Stars-Changes-Conrad-Green-Season17-1070353.aspx|archive-date = September 18, 2013|url-status = live}} This season also introduced a new format of voting. Each week, the judges would give each couple a score. Since there was no results show, those scores would be added to the public votes from the previous week, and the couple with the lowest combined score from judges and viewer votes would be eliminated from the competition at the end of that week's episode.{{cite web|url = http://abc.go.com/shows/dancing-with-the-stars/vote-faq|title = Voting — Frequently Asked Questions|publisher = ABC|access-date = 2013-09-21|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20110315002803/http://abc.go.com/shows/dancing-with-the-stars/vote-faq|archive-date = 2011-03-15|url-status = live}} ==Cast== ===Couples=== This season featured twelve celebrity contestants.
